title: Real Mac mini IVE autocode replay corpus

episodes.title: Trueskill CPCV future leakage and missing calibration
episodes.finding_summary: A cross-validation path allowed future information into OOF-style evidence and treated missing calibration as if the result were promotable.
episodes.aha_pattern: IVE should stop the autocode loop before celebrating a metric when the temporal split and calibration proof are absent.

route.concept_guard: Temporal OOF evidence must prove train windows are known before test windows and calibration is present before any performance claim.
acceptance_criteria: Replay fixture rejects CPCV evidence that trains on future periods relative to the test window.
Closeout states no ROI, edge, or model-performance claim until temporal lineage and calibration proof are present.
route.verification_required: Temporal fold audit plus calibration evidence or explicit no-promotion boundary.
route.stop_condition: Stop once future-leaking evidence is routed to a repair ticket instead of a result claim.
route.recurrence_guard: Future quant replay episodes must declare known-at-time and leakage boundaries.

knowledge_trigger.title: Too-good quant results need temporal proof before celebration
knowledge_trigger.directive: When a quant metric looks surprisingly strong, route to leakage and calibration proof before summarizing success.

quant_guard.target_outcome: honest temporal OOF validity before any tennis model claim
quant_guard.data_lineage: hashed Trueskill retro and mistake references only; no raw odds or match rows loaded
quant_guard.known_at_time: fixture records only facts known in the cited retro/mistake files
quant_guard.leakage_boundary: training evidence must be strictly earlier than evaluation evidence; CPCV future-to-past leakage is disallowed
quant_guard.baseline: honest walk-forward and market/control baselines, not future-leaking CPCV output
quant_guard.calibration: missing calibration blocks promotion; fixture performs no calibration fit

non_claims: No tennis ROI, alpha, betting, or model-performance claim is made by this replay.

episodes.title: Trueskill stale odds file silently truncated recent backtest data
episodes.finding_summary: A backtest silently used stale odds coverage and ignored modern rows, creating a misleading sense that the run covered the intended date range.
episodes.aha_pattern: IVE should surface the date-coverage mismatch as a first-class fact before any backtest summary is accepted.

route.concept_guard: Backtest evidence must prove requested date range, available odds range, retained match range, and dropped-row count.
acceptance_criteria: Replay fixture requires date coverage alignment before a backtest can close.
Report states stale odds coverage as a limitation when modern rows are missing.
route.verification_required: Date range audit over requested, source, retained, and omitted rows.
route.stop_condition: Stop once stale data is visible as a ticketed coverage gap.
route.recurrence_guard: Future backtest fixtures must include a source coverage check.

knowledge_trigger.title: Backtest coverage is a claim boundary
knowledge_trigger.directive: Always compare requested and actual date ranges before summarizing a backtest.

quant_guard.target_outcome: date coverage honesty before tennis backtest interpretation
quant_guard.data_lineage: hashed Trueskill stale-odds retro reference only
quant_guard.known_at_time: fixture metadata and retro id only
quant_guard.leakage_boundary: no future data is loaded; stale coverage must be declared instead of hidden
quant_guard.baseline: requested date range and market/control coverage are the comparison baseline
quant_guard.calibration: not_applicable: fixture performs no probability calibration

non_claims: No backtest coverage or performance claim is made from stale odds evidence.

episodes.title: Trueskill fast-eval smoke result treated as a final edge
episodes.finding_summary: A fast evaluation endpoint was used as if it were the canonical joint-search pipeline, so a smoke-class output was framed as final edge evidence.
episodes.aha_pattern: IVE should propose the canonical experiment rather than accept a smoke endpoint as the answer.

route.concept_guard: Run class and canonical pipeline identity must be explicit before interpreting optimization output.
route.verification_required: Run the canonical joint search or record that only smoke evidence exists.
route.stop_condition: Stop once the next experiment is the canonical pipeline, not more prose about the smoke result.
route.recurrence_guard: Future optimizer closeouts must disclose run class and endpoint identity.

knowledge_trigger.title: Smoke endpoints are wiring proof, not final evidence
knowledge_trigger.directive: If the agent used a fast path, surface the serious-search path as the next experiment.

quant_guard.data_lineage: hashed Trueskill optimization retro reference only
quant_guard.known_at_time: fixture metadata and retro id only
quant_guard.leakage_boundary: no future rows loaded; the boundary is run-class disclosure and endpoint identity
quant_guard.baseline: canonical joint-search pipeline with frozen objective
quant_guard.calibration: not_applicable: fixture does not fit or calibrate a model

non_claims: No ROI or edge claim is made from smoke-class optimizer output.

episodes.title: Trueskill model was worse than market but needed honest limitation
episodes.finding_summary: A model search produced results that were worse than the market/control baseline and needed to close as a limitation, not as an improvement story.
episodes.aha_pattern: IVE should accept the negative result as a bounded finding and stop promotion language.

route.concept_guard: When the control beats the model, the valid closeout is a limitation and next-research boundary.
route.claim_boundary: No positive edge, promotion, or model-improvement claim is allowed while the market/control baseline wins.
route.verification_required: Control-baseline comparison is explicit and negative result is preserved.
route.stop_condition: Stop once the limitation is visible and no promotion claim remains.
route.recurrence_guard: Future result summaries must compare against controls before claiming progress.

knowledge_trigger.title: A negative control result is useful memory
knowledge_trigger.directive: Store model-worse-than-control outcomes as constraints on the next experiment, not as failed work to gloss over.

quant_guard.target_outcome: honest result boundary when control beats model
quant_guard.data_lineage: hashed Trueskill model-worse-than-market retro reference only
quant_guard.known_at_time: fixture metadata and retro id only
quant_guard.leakage_boundary: no leakage claim is made; the control comparison blocks promotion
quant_guard.baseline: market/control baseline is authoritative for this fixture
quant_guard.calibration: not_applicable: fixture does not fit or calibrate a model

non_claims: No positive model, market, ROI, or betting claim is made.

episodes.title: Trueskill features were wired into one model path but invisible to another
episodes.finding_summary: New features were registered in one modeling path but remained invisible to the primary production path because the project had dual registration systems.
episodes.aha_pattern: IVE should turn feature addition into a parity check across model consumers.

route.concept_guard: Feature registration is not complete until every declared model consumer can see the feature.
route.verification_required: Feature registry parity assertion across MetaLogit, CatBoost, and stage-zero ranking surfaces.
route.stop_condition: Stop once feature visibility is tested across consumers.
route.recurrence_guard: Future feature tickets must include consumer parity evidence.

knowledge_trigger.title: Feature work needs consumer parity proof
knowledge_trigger.directive: When adding model features, ask which consumers cannot see them yet.

quant_guard.target_outcome: feature visibility parity before model-result interpretation
quant_guard.data_lineage: hashed Trueskill feature retro and mistake references only
quant_guard.known_at_time: fixture metadata and source ids only
quant_guard.leakage_boundary: no model rows loaded; feature leakage is guarded by consumer parity and allowlist review
quant_guard.baseline: all declared production model consumers see the same intended feature set
quant_guard.calibration: not_applicable: fixture does not fit or calibrate a model

non_claims: No model gain claim is made from feature registration alone.

episodes.title: IPBS UFC report blocked promotion but missed operator advice
episodes.finding_summary: Promotion governance correctly blocked the UFC model, but the operator-facing report failed to provide the practical advice, ideas, and performance summary the user needed.
episodes.aha_pattern: IVE should not stop at blocked/not-blocked; it should surface next useful operator decisions and experiments.

route.concept_guard: A correct no-promotion verdict is incomplete when the operator asked for decision support and next ideas.
acceptance_criteria: Replay fixture requires operator-facing next actions after a blocked promotion verdict.
Report separates governance block, current best control, and candidate experiments.
route.verification_required: Operator advice section with controls, blockers, and ranked next experiments.
route.stop_condition: Stop once the blocked model produces useful operator next steps.
route.recurrence_guard: Future blocked-promotion reports must include decision-support output.

knowledge_trigger.title: A correct block still owes the operator a next move
knowledge_trigger.directive: When promotion is blocked, rank the smallest next experiment that would remove a blocker.

quant_guard.target_outcome: operator decision support after blocked UFC model promotion
quant_guard.data_lineage: hashed IPBS UFC operator retro reference only
quant_guard.known_at_time: fixture metadata and retro id only
quant_guard.leakage_boundary: no bet rows loaded; no promotion while control and evidence blockers remain
quant_guard.baseline: control strategy and market favorite comparisons remain visible
quant_guard.calibration: not_applicable: fixture does not fit or calibrate a model

non_claims: No UFC promotion or betting edge claim is made.

episodes.title: IPBS verification blocked aggregate blends without bet-level OOS proof
episodes.finding_summary: Aggregate-only evidence could not prove bet-level OOS behavior, so promotion had to remain blocked despite higher-level summaries.
episodes.aha_pattern: IVE should preserve the no-promotion limitation and point to the missing bet-level artifact.

route.concept_guard: Aggregate metrics cannot stand in for bet-level OOS verification.
route.claim_boundary: No promotion or edge claim is allowed until bet-level OOS records exist.
route.verification_required: Bet-level OOS artifact with reference prices, selected bets, and daily PnL lineage.
route.stop_condition: Stop once the missing bet-level artifact is explicit.
route.recurrence_guard: Future aggregate blend reports must declare whether bet-level OOS evidence exists.

knowledge_trigger.title: Aggregate blend proof is not bet-level proof
knowledge_trigger.directive: Before accepting blend evidence, ask whether selected-bet records and reference prices are persisted.

quant_guard.target_outcome: bet-level OOS evidence before IPBS promotion
quant_guard.data_lineage: hashed IPBS verification summary reference only
quant_guard.known_at_time: fixture metadata and verification id only
quant_guard.leakage_boundary: no downstream promotion without bet-level known-at-time records
quant_guard.baseline: control and aggregate-only evidence are insufficient for promotion
quant_guard.calibration: not_applicable: fixture does not fit or calibrate a model

non_claims: No promotion claim is made from aggregate-only evidence.

episodes.title: IPBS Platt calibration proof used train-fold fit and validation-fold evaluation
episodes.finding_summary: A calibration proof explicitly fit on the train fold and evaluated on a later validation fold, giving IVE a positive guard pattern to preserve.
episodes.aha_pattern: IVE should remember positive proof shapes, not only failures, so future runs can ask for the same guard.

route.concept_guard: Temporal calibration proof requires train-fold fit and later validation-fold evaluation.
route.verification_required: Keep the temporal calibration guard as a reusable replay pattern.
route.stop_condition: Stop once the guard is encoded and no promotion claim is inferred.
route.recurrence_guard: Future calibration tickets can reuse this positive proof shape.

knowledge_trigger.title: Positive calibration proof should become a reusable guard
knowledge_trigger.directive: When a calibration proof is clean, preserve its fit/evaluate boundary as a template.

quant_guard.data_lineage: hashed IPBS Platt calibration verification reference only
quant_guard.known_at_time: fixture metadata and verification id only
quant_guard.leakage_boundary: calibrator fit fold must be before evaluation fold
quant_guard.baseline: uncalibrated or same-fold calibration is the rejected baseline
quant_guard.calibration: train-fold Platt fit evaluated on validation fold; fixture performs no live fit

non_claims: No calibrated edge claim is made; the fixture only preserves a proof shape.

episodes.title: Polymarket final model trained on the full dataset including test period
episodes.finding_summary: A final model fit used the whole dataset, including the test period, which made a perfect-looking result invalid as alpha evidence.
episodes.aha_pattern: IVE should convert impressive post-hoc metrics into a leakage repair ticket before the autocode loop continues.

route.concept_guard: Final training must exclude evaluation windows when a test-period claim is being made.
acceptance_criteria: Replay fixture requires final train mask and test window boundaries.
Any perfect or near-perfect metric is non-promotable until leakage proof passes.
route.verification_required: Temporal train/test mask proof plus no-alpha claim boundary.
route.stop_condition: Stop once full-dataset training is ticketed as leakage.
route.recurrence_guard: Future final-model tickets must record train mask and as-of boundary.

knowledge_trigger.title: Perfect alpha usually asks for a leakage audit first
knowledge_trigger.directive: When a market model looks perfect, route to final-train-mask proof before reporting alpha.

quant_guard.target_outcome: temporal final-model train mask before Polymarket alpha interpretation
quant_guard.known_at_time: fixture metadata and mistake id only
quant_guard.leakage_boundary: final model training cannot include the claimed test period
quant_guard.baseline: time-split train/test evaluation with no future market outcomes in training
quant_guard.calibration: not_applicable: fixture does not fit or calibrate a model

non_claims: No Polymarket alpha or win-rate claim is made.

episodes.title: Polymarket stale hyperparameter cache survived a split change
episodes.finding_summary: A hyperparameter cache keyed only by model name survived a temporal split change, so old parameters could be reused under a new evaluation contract.
episodes.aha_pattern: IVE should see a split change as a cache-invalidation boundary.

route.concept_guard: Cache keys for optimization results must include split definition, data digest, objective, and search surface.
route.verification_required: Cache key fixture proves split changes invalidate old optimization artifacts.
route.stop_condition: Stop once stale cache reuse is impossible after split changes.
route.recurrence_guard: Future optimizer cache tickets must include split and data digest in the key.

knowledge_trigger.title: Split changes invalidate optimizer caches
knowledge_trigger.directive: When a temporal split changes, ask which caches need new keys.

quant_guard.target_outcome: cache/split parity before optimizer result reuse
quant_guard.data_lineage: hashed Polymarket stale-cache mistake reference only
quant_guard.known_at_time: fixture metadata and mistake id only
quant_guard.leakage_boundary: old params cannot cross a changed temporal split boundary
quant_guard.baseline: cache key includes split, data digest, objective, and search surface
quant_guard.calibration: not_applicable: fixture does not fit or calibrate a model

non_claims: No optimizer result claim is made from stale cached parameters.

episodes.title: Polymarket underpowered optimizer run was framed as beefy
episodes.finding_summary: A small optimizer run was described with stronger language than its trial count, data size, and search-surface proof justified.
episodes.aha_pattern: IVE should accept only the limitation and ask for scale disclosure before stronger claims.

route.concept_guard: Optimizer scale language must match trial count, data size, search surface, and objective freeze status.
route.claim_boundary: No serious-search or alpha claim is allowed from underpowered optimizer evidence.
route.stop_condition: Stop once the run is labeled exploratory or smoke-class.
route.recurrence_guard: Future optimizer summaries must disclose run class and search surface.

knowledge_trigger.title: Optimizer adjectives are evidence claims
knowledge_trigger.directive: Tie optimizer language to trial count, search surface, data size, and frozen objective.

quant_guard.target_outcome: optimizer scale disclosure before Polymarket claim language
quant_guard.data_lineage: hashed Polymarket optimizer-scale mistake reference only
quant_guard.known_at_time: fixture metadata and mistake id only
quant_guard.leakage_boundary: no future market data loaded; run-class boundary blocks promotion
quant_guard.baseline: serious search requires adequate trials, frozen objective, and declared search surface
quant_guard.calibration: not_applicable: fixture does not fit or calibrate a model

non_claims: No alpha, serious-search, or optimizer-success claim is made.

episodes.title: ValueInvestingAI shift(-1) feature leaked future values
episodes.finding_summary: A time-series feature shape used a future shift, which is a direct leakage smell for prediction-time features.
episodes.aha_pattern: IVE should translate a tiny code smell into a hard temporal feature guard.

route.concept_guard: Prediction-time features must not use negative shifts or future target information.
route.verification_required: Static and behavioral feature-lag guard for negative shift patterns.
route.stop_condition: Stop once future-shift features are rejected.
route.recurrence_guard: Future feature engineering tickets must include lag-direction checks.

knowledge_trigger.title: Negative shifts are leakage until proven otherwise
knowledge_trigger.directive: When reviewing time-series features, scan for future shifts and target-aware transforms.

quant_guard.known_at_time: fixture metadata and gotcha id only
quant_guard.leakage_boundary: features must be known at prediction time and cannot use shift(-1) style future values
quant_guard.baseline: lagged features with positive known-at-time shifts
quant_guard.calibration: not_applicable: fixture does not fit or calibrate a model

non_claims: No investment model performance claim is made.

episodes.title: ValueInvestingAI target-aware postprocessing contaminated claims
episodes.finding_summary: Prediction postprocessing used target-aware information on the same OOF set, contaminating any downstream claim that used those predictions.
episodes.aha_pattern: IVE should route postprocessing as part of the leakage boundary, not only model training.

route.concept_guard: Postprocessing and calibration steps must be fit on data disjoint from the claims they evaluate.
acceptance_criteria: Replay fixture treats target-aware prediction edits as leakage unless fit/evaluate separation is proven.
Closeout separates model output, postprocessing, and claim boundary.
route.verification_required: OOF postprocessing lineage and disjoint fit/evaluate proof.
route.stop_condition: Stop once target-aware postprocessing is ticketed as leakage risk.
route.recurrence_guard: Future postprocessing tickets must declare whether targets were visible.

knowledge_trigger.title: Postprocessing can leak too
knowledge_trigger.directive: Include calibration and prediction-edit steps in the leakage boundary, not only training.

quant_guard.target_outcome: postprocessing leakage boundary before investment model claims
quant_guard.data_lineage: hashed ValueInvestingAI target-aware postprocessing gotcha reference only
quant_guard.known_at_time: fixture metadata and gotcha id only
quant_guard.leakage_boundary: postprocessing cannot use targets from the same OOF/evaluation set used for claims
quant_guard.baseline: fit postprocessor on disjoint training data or use untouched OOF predictions
quant_guard.calibration: calibration/postprocessing must have disjoint fit and evaluation lineage

non_claims: No investment return or model-quality claim is made.

episodes.title: Evolution stale daemon and weak tests made a fix appear to fail
episodes.finding_summary: A running automation service and weak isolation made the operator believe a fix had failed, even though the tested process was not necessarily the new code.
episodes.aha_pattern: IVE should pause automode and ask which daemon, process, and log target are authoritative before continuing.

route.concept_guard: Autocode verification must bind the running process, launched config, and observed logs to the code just changed.
route.verification_required: Operator confirms live daemon identity or the loop restarts under a captured launch contract.
route.stop_condition: Stop once the active process identity is known before more fixes are generated.
route.recurrence_guard: Future automation fixes must include process identity and restart proof.

knowledge_trigger.title: Autocode loops need live-process identity
knowledge_trigger.directive: Before iterating on an automation failure, verify the running process, config source, and log stream.

non_claims: No trading, optimizer, or live automation success claim is made.
